title: Jehoshaphat proclaims a fast throughout Judah
speaker: King Jehoshaphat
note: Outside candidate list (20:3). Royal fast proclamation, like ot-jonah-v3-7 and first-pass P01193 (Ezra 8:21).

title: Jehu orders a search for Ahaziah, who is caught and killed
speaker: Jehu
note: Reported order. Kings parallel 2 Kings 9:27 ('strike him too') is also unrecorded.

title: Jehoiada and his sons crown and anoint Joash king
speaker: Jehoiada the priest and his sons
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Same act as first-pass P00925 (2 Kings 11:12, new); link them as parallels. AUD-14-23-3 records only the call (23:3).

title: Joash orders a collection for annual temple repairs
speaker: King Joash
note: Joash presses Jehoiada to make the Levites bring the levy Moses prescribed; same collection order.

title: Amaziah threatens the prophet who rebukes him
speaker: prophets sent by the Lord; King Amaziah
note: Adds the rebuke itself: why seek gods that could not save their own people? 25:16 calls it 'my counsel'.

title: Oded calls on Israel to send Judah’s captives back
speaker: Oded, the Lord’s prophet
note: Oded’s address opens at 28:9; the rebuke (28:9–10) grounds the release command.

title: Hezekiah tells the Levites to purify themselves and the temple
speaker: King Hezekiah
note: Outside candidate list (29:4, never batched): Hezekiah gathers and stations those he addresses. 29:15 reports their compliance.

title: The Passover letters call the survivors of Israel back to the Lord
speaker: King Hezekiah
recipient: Israel and Judah, Ephraim and Manasseh
note: 30:1 first reports the same Passover letters; link it here, or widen first-pass P01033 (30:2–5) to 30:1–5.

title: The assembly resolves to keep the feast seven more days
speaker: the whole assembly in Jerusalem
note: Communal festival decision, like first-pass P01033 (30:2–5).

title: Hezekiah orders storerooms prepared in the temple for the offerings
speaker: King Hezekiah

title: Hezekiah and Azarias appoint Levites to oversee and distribute the offerings
speaker: King Hezekiah and Azarias, leader of the Lord’s house
recipient: Chonenias, Semei, Kore and the Levite overseers
note: 31:13 'as King Hezekiah and Azarias commanded'; 31:12 and 31:14–15 outside candidate list.

title: Hezekiah appoints commanders of war over the people
speaker: King Hezekiah
note: He then gathers them for the 32:7–8 speech (ot-2-chronicles-v32-7).

title: Josiah sends his officials to seek the Lord about the recovered book
speaker: King Josiah
recipient: Hilkiah, Ahikam, Abdon, Shaphan and Asaias
note: 34:20 names the officials commanded; cf. first-pass P00951 (2 Kings 22:12–13).

title: Josiah summons the elders and reads the covenant book to all
speaker: King Josiah
recipient: the elders of Judah and Jerusalem; all the people
note: Kings parallel 2 Kings 23:1–2 also unrecorded; the covenant follows (first-pass P01047, 34:31–32).

title: Josiah stations the priests at their duties and strengthens them
speaker: King Josiah
note: Outside candidate list (35:2, never batched); precedes his charge to the Levites (ot-2-chronicles-v35-3).

title: Laments for Josiah are made an ordinance in Israel
speaker: the male and female rulers of Judah
note: Customary ordinance of mourning, like first-pass P00624 (Judges 11:39–40).

title: Pharaoh Neco makes Eliakim king, renaming him Jehoiakim
speaker: Pharaoh Neco
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (36:4). Kings parallel 2 Kings 23:34 also unrecorded.

title: Pharaoh imposes tribute, which Jehoiakim exacts from the land by assessment
speaker: Pharaoh Neco
note: 36:3 outside candidate list (never batched); 36:4a 'at Pharaoh’s command'. 2 Kings 23:33–35 also unrecorded.

title: Nebuchadnezzar makes Zedekiah king and binds him by oath
speaker: King Nebuchadnezzar
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Also deports Jechonias (36:10). 2 Kings 24:17 unrecorded; the broken oath is treated in AUD-30-17-11 (Ezekiel 17).

title: Antiochus sends a chief tribute collector, who treacherously strikes Jerusalem
speaker: King Antiochus Epiphanes
note: Same mission as first-pass P01142 (2 Maccabees 5:24, Apollonius); link them as parallels.

title: The king’s decree executes keepers of the covenant book and circumcisers
speaker: King Antiochus Epiphanes, through his officers
note: Law books burned; owning one or keeping the law is capital (1:57), applying ot-1-maccabees-v1-48 and v1-49.

title: The king’s officers press Mattathias to obey the decree first
speaker: the king’s officials
note: 2:17 opens the same appeal, flattering Mattathias’s standing.

title: Judas orders men to fight the citadel garrison during the cleansing
speaker: Judas Maccabeus

title: Judas chooses blameless priests to cleanse the holy places
speaker: Judas Maccabeus
recipient: blameless priests devoted to the law
note: Carries out the cleansing proposed in ot-1-maccabees-v4-36.

title: The priests store the defiled altar’s stones until a prophet decides
speaker: the chosen priests, with Judas
note: Ruling on the profaned altar (4:44–45 outside candidate list); new altar of whole stones 'according to the law' (4:47).

title: Judas sends men to spy out Timothy’s camp
speaker: Judas Maccabeus
note: Like ot-joshua-v2-1 (spies sent).

title: The king’s side proposes peace and restoration of Jewish customs
speaker: Lysias; King Antiochus Eupator
recipient: the king, commanders and men; the besieged Jews
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 6:57 opens Lysias’s proposal; 6:60–61 the king accepts, sends terms and swears. Parallel 2 Maccabees 13:23.

title: Alcimus urges Demetrius to investigate and punish Judas’s supporters
speaker: Alcimus and the lawless men of Israel
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The accusation (7:6) opens the same appeal.

title: Demetrius sends Bacchides to take vengeance and confirms Alcimus as priest
speaker: King Demetrius
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Demetrius sends them again at 9:1 (Q04539); link that verse here.

title: Bacchides places the country under Alcimus with a supporting force
speaker: Bacchides
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (7:20).

title: Judas sends envoys to Rome to seek alliance and friendship
speaker: Judas Maccabeus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 8:17–19 outside candidate list; 8:20 is their request to the senate. The treaty is AUD-15-8-24.

title: Jonathan sends John to ask the Nabateans to store their goods
speaker: Jonathan
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Sending with a request; the brother is named John in 9:36.

title: Bacchides secretly writes to his Judean allies to seize Jonathan
speaker: Bacchides
note: Acts on the plot recorded at ot-1-maccabees-v9-58.

title: Alexander asks for Ptolemy’s daughter in marriage
speaker: King Alexander, through envoys
note: The envoys sent and the letter’s opening (10:51–53) lead into the request.

title: Ptolemy agrees to a marriage alliance and proposes a meeting
speaker: King Ptolemy
note: 10:55 opens Ptolemy’s reply.

title: Demetrius appoints Apollonius, governor of Coele-Syria, to lead his forces
speaker: King Demetrius
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: His challenge to Jonathan follows (first-pass P01105, 10:70–73).

title: Jonathan’s troops stand firm under the ambush as he commanded
speaker: Jonathan
note: Reported order; its wording is not given.

title: Alexander grants Jonathan a golden clasp and Ekron as an inheritance
speaker: King Alexander
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Royal grant, like the catalogue’s itemized Seleucid grants (e.g. ot-1-maccabees-v11-34).

title: Demetrius confirms Jonathan as high priest and ranks him among First Friends
speaker: King Demetrius
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (11:27, never batched).

title: Jonathan asks Demetrius to free Judea and the three districts from tribute
speaker: Jonathan
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (11:28, never batched); the king consents (11:29) and grants it in ot-1-maccabees-v11-34.

title: Rome gives Jonathan’s envoys letters ordering safe escort home
speaker: the Roman council
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 12:4 outside candidate list. The embassy itself is first-pass P01111 (12:1–2), which could widen to 12:3.

title: Remember your brothers continually in prayers and sacrifices
speaker: Jonathan, the elders and the Jewish people
note: Maxim in the letter: 'as it is right and fitting to remember brothers'. The letter’s request is first-pass P01112.

title: Areus asks Onias to write and orders their shared property reported
speaker: Areus king of the Spartans
recipient: Onias the high priest; Areus’s envoys
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Request (12:22) and 'We therefore command that they report to you' (12:23), declaring property shared.

title: Tryphon sends forces to destroy all Jonathan’s men in Galilee
speaker: Tryphon
note: Like AUD-15-16-17 (Ptolemy sends agents against John).

title: Simon sends Jonathan son of Absalom with a force to take Joppa
speaker: Simon

title: Tryphon demands silver and hostages for Jonathan’s release
speaker: Tryphon, through envoys
note: Tryphon’s envoys and the debt pretext (13:14–15) open the same demand.

title: Simon sends envoys to Demetrius to seek remission for the country
speaker: Simon
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Demetrius’s reply is first-pass P01120 (13:36–39).

title: Arsaces sends a commander to capture Demetrius alive
speaker: Arsaces king of Persia and Media

title: The decree forbids annulling Simon’s terms or rivaling his authority
speaker: the great assembly of priests, people, rulers and elders
note: Obedience; no contradicting him, convening without him, or wearing purple; penalty (14:45). Inside ot-1-maccabees-v14-41, whose title omits these.

title: Simon charges his sons to lead the nation in battle
speaker: Simon
note: 16:2 names the sons summoned and opens the charge.

title: Heliodorus’s companions beg Onias to pray for his life
speaker: some of Heliodorus’s companions
note: Outside candidate list (3:31). Onias’s sacrifice and the angels’ charge follow (ot-2-maccabees-v3-33).

title: Jason’s envoys ask that his gift for Heracles not fund sacrifice
speaker: the envoys Jason sent to Tyre
note: Jason sent the money for the sacrifice; the bearers’ scruple redirected it (4:20). 2 Maccabees 4 has no records.

title: Antiochus gives Menelaus, Jason’s envoy, the high priesthood by royal orders
speaker: Jason; King Antiochus Epiphanes
note: Jason sends Menelaus with the money (4:23); 4:24–25 outside candidate list (4:25 never batched).

title: The elders’ council sends three men to accuse Menelaus
speaker: the council of elders

title: God chose the place for the nation, not the reverse
speaker: the narrator (the epitomist)
note: Outside candidate list (5:19–20). Teaches that the sanctuary shares the people’s sins and fortunes; cf. AUD-16-6-12.

title: Eleazar refuses to mislead younger people by pretending to break the law
speaker: Eleazar; the narrator
recipient: his persecutors; the young and the nation
note: Adds his dying words and the narrator’s 'example of nobility' (6:30–31); first-pass P01143 adds 6:18–20.

title: The torturers demand the second brother eat pork or be dismembered
speaker: the king’s torturers
note: The compulsion of 7:1 is also unrecorded; first-pass P01144 covers the king’s orders in 7:3–5.

title: Antiochus Eupator appoints Lysias chief minister and governor of Coele-Syria
speaker: King Antiochus Eupator
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Distinct from first-pass P01060 (Antiochus IV leaves Lysias regent, 1 Maccabees 3:32–36).

title: Maccabeus leaves Simon, Joseph and Zacchaeus to besiege the towers
speaker: Judas Maccabeus
note: Outside candidate list (10:19); their men’s bribery follows (10:20–22).

title: Lysias’s letter urges the Jews’ goodwill and sends negotiators
speaker: Lysias
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 11:18–21 outside candidate list (never batched); Lysias’s proposal is first-pass P01161 (11:13–15).

title: The king’s side proposes peace and restoration of Jewish customs
speaker: King Antiochus Eupator
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Same settlement after Philip’s revolt as 1 Maccabees 6:57–61; 13:24 also appoints Hegemonides governor.

title: Judas posts armed men at key points against treachery
speaker: Judas Maccabeus
note: Outside candidate list (14:22); cf. AUD-15-12-26 (Jonathan’s armed watch).

title: Cyrus calls for volunteers to rebuild God’s house in Jerusalem
speaker: Cyrus king of the Persians
recipient: his whole kingdom; the Lord’s people
note: 1:1 is the order to proclaim it in writing; the record already links 2 Chronicles 36:22–23, which includes it.

title: Cyrus directs that the temple vessels be returned
speaker: Cyrus king of the Persians
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (never batched): Cyrus has the vessels counted out to Sasabasar, the act Ezra 5:14–15 recalls.

title: Zorobabel and Iesous set the Levites over the temple work
speaker: Zorobabel, Iesous and the returned priests and Levites
recipient: the Levites from twenty years old and upward
note: Outside candidate list (3:8 never batched, 3:9 context); Ezra 3 has no records.

title: Arthasastha orders the records searched and finds Jerusalem rebellious
speaker: King Arthasastha
recipient: his officials; Raoum, Samsai and their colleagues
note: 4:19 'I issued a decision, and we searched'; cf. Darius’s search (first-pass P01191). Stop order is P01188 (4:21–22).

title: Cyrus’s archived decree authorizes rebuilding the temple and altar
speaker: King Cyrus, as cited by the Jewish elders
note: Outside candidate list (5:13): the elders cite Cyrus’s building decree.

title: Cyrus directs that the temple vessels be returned
speaker: King Cyrus
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 5:14 names Sasabasar, who receives the vessels and the order.

title: The exiles station priests and Levites in their divisions per Moses’ book
speaker: the returned exiles
note: Outside candidate list (never batched).

title: Arthasastha sends Ezra to inspect Judea and Jerusalem by God’s law
speaker: King Arthasastha and his seven advisers
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life

title: The king entrusts Ezra with offerings and funds for the temple
speaker: King Arthasastha
note: 7:15–16 (outside candidate list) list the silver, gold and freewill gifts that 7:17–20 assigns; one sentence.

title: Ezra recalls the ban on intermarriage with the peoples of the land
speaker: Ezra, citing the Lord through the prophets
note: The quoted commandment begins in 9:11.

title: Shecaniah proposes an oath to send away foreign wives and their children
speaker: Sechenias son of Iiel
note: 10:2 opens the same proposal: confession and 'there is patient hope for Israel'.

title: Ezra calls the assembly to separate from foreign wives
speaker: Esdras (Ezra) the priest
recipient: the men of Judah and Benjamin
note: 10:10 opens Ezra’s charge with the indictment.

title: The assembly proposes scheduled hearings for foreign marriages
speaker: the whole assembly
note: 10:12–13 open the assembly’s reply that leads to the proposal.

title: The guilty priests pledge to dismiss their wives and offer a ram
speaker: the priests of Iesous’s family
note: Pledge with a guilt-offering ram, carrying out the oath of 10:5 (first-pass P01196).

title: Sanballat uses an accusation to press Nehemiah for a meeting
speaker: Sanaballat
note: The open letter’s accusation (6:5–6) is the same message.

title: Nehemiah has gatekeepers, singers and Levites appointed
speaker: Nehemiah
note: Precedes his orders for the gates (ot-nehemiah-v7-3).

title: A royal command governs the temple singers
speaker: the Persian king
note: Reported royal order; the Saints text gives no content.

title: The king orders Mordecai to serve at court and rewards him
speaker: King Artaxerxes
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Addition A; the record-keeping in 1:1p parallels first-pass P01227 (2:23).

title: The advisers propose removing Vashti by royal decree
speaker: Muchaeus
note: Muchaeus’s speech opens at 1:16; 1:16–18 give the grounds for the decree.

title: Persian law: uninvited entry to the king’s inner court means death
speaker: Persian royal law, cited by Esther
note: Only one to whom the king extends the golden sceptre lives; Esther goes 'contrary to the law' (4:16).

title: Esther asks the Jews of Susa to fast before she approaches the king
speaker: Queen Esther
recipient: Mordecai and the Jews in Susa
note: 4:15 introduces Esther’s message to Mordecai.

title: Mordecai warns Esther that the palace will not spare her
speaker: Mordecai
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Outside candidate list (4:14): the warning continues, 'Who knows whether you became queen for this time?'

summary: 84 findings in 70 of 161 passages: unrecorded commissions, reported orders and royal letters in Chronicles, Maccabees and Ezra, speech openings to extend, and laws such as the Persian inner-court rule and Simon’s decree prohibitions.
